property_summary: For any actor and any future unlock time t, after depositing v (>= MinSum) via Put(t), an attempt to Collect before time t must be a no-op (the deposited balance remains intact), but the mutant never sets unlockTime so the same Collect drains the full balance.
change_summary: Delete the unlockTime assignment so Put no longer updates the caller's unlock time.
